nuggets.text: DeJuan Williams opened Maryland's season with a 94-yard touchdown run, the second-longest run in Terrapins history.
DeJuan Williams ran for 116 yards and two touchdowns on just three carries in the Terrapins' opener.
The Terrapins bring a 19-game non-conference winning streak into this game, the longest in FBS.
Maryland offensive coordinator Clint Trickett was featured on Netflix's Last Chance U while coaching at East Mississippi.
Mike Locksley won the Broyles Award, given to the nation's top assistant, as Alabama's offensive coordinator in 2018.
DD Holmes and Eyan Thomas each had two sacks as the Terrapins opened with a 62-0 shutout.
Maryland students rub the nose of the Testudo statue outside McKeldin Library for good luck.
Johns Hopkins students stole Maryland's Testudo statue in 1947; it was later filled with 700 pounds of cement.
Maryland adopted the Terrapin nickname in 1933, after the diamondback terrapin, a turtle native to the state.
Maryland claims the 1953 national championship, won in a 10-1 season.
